title: The Wagon-Wheel Effect: Why Wheels Spin Backwards
caption:
Why do fast wheels look like they spin backwards?
A cartoon passenger gawks at a zooming sports car whose wheel seems to spin backwards, then an office fan repeats the trick before a futuristic brain panel drops the diagnosis.
The wagon-wheel effect: your brain samples vision in frames, so a fast wheel can strobe and appear to rotate in reverse.
Where have you caught it - highway wheels or a spinning desk fan?
Save this one and share it with a friend who swears their eyes are broken.
